collision_state_priority: RECOVER > active R2/R3 > normal within3s after actual R3 handover > NORMAL_GRAPH/RAW. Keep underlying path state separately; rejected R3 END is not handover.
current_path: Last repair.jsonl PATH_APPLIED by contact time; command source/controller corroborates. Paths called HANDOFF/GRAPH18 are Graph; no such collision in this17-run set.
clearance: Logged selection lower bound or accepted near/far certificate; plus common base occupied-site exact distance on B-projected suffix and original evaluator oracle polyline/swept distances. These are not interchangeable.
depth_first_seen: Saved first_occupied_tick on grid centers inside oracle box plus half-cell diagonal tolerance. Dynamic cells require first_tick>=spawn tick; oracle only matches cells for analysis. Publish sim time interpolated from original72Hz monotonic timestamps. No RGB inference or replayed mapping.
depth_censoring: Use last archived snapshot published before contact. Record capture gap; occupancy history after that map is not invented. New cells observed after installation do not mean the whole box was first observed then.
terminal_window: First72Hz goal distance<=.6m through actual termination, for both failures and same-scene/seed successes. Different duration windows, not a causal matched intervention.
terminal_state_priority: RECOVER > R2/R3 executing (DETOUR, includes its alignment) > SP ALIGN_ROTATE > abs(v)>=.02 DRIVE > STOP. Physical abs(v)<.02 overlap is separate. BRAKE auxiliary column, not hidden inside alignment rotation.
candidates: All8 native endpoints transformed at saved observation pose; count outputs available at received_sim_s in window. All-sample, any-per-event, FRESHEST and selected ratios separate. FRESHEST determined by B-suffix remaining length.
topomap: Closest_node equals saved goal_node exactly; last-value held between received outputs for time ratio. Selected subgoal not equated to localization.
retreats: 10cm directional-change hysteresis; report retreat starts and complete retreat-then-approach cycles; .70 exit/.60 reentry also reported.
controls: Every successful other method same scene/index in deduplicated Phase31-D runs. Changed H versions kept distinct, not pooled as identical; unique controls in overall summary. Missing successful controls explicit.
causal_limit: Execution state and planned/actual clearance are evidence, not proof that solver or soft factor alone caused collision. Collision-selected paths have no exposure denominator; do not infer method-state collision rates.
